claims.text: Places Ranked by Female Primary Teachers
claims.support: Indicator: SE.PRM.TCHR.FE.ZS, definition: Female teachers as a percentage of total primary education teachers

claims.text: A documentary overview ranking countries and territories by the share of female primary school teachers, from South Sudan to Belarus.
In South Sudan, 14.5 percent of primary teachers are women. In Belarus, it's 99.5 percent.
South Sudan is the world's lowest, counting both full-time and part-time staff.
claims.support: SSD rank 171 (lowest among 171 count); definition: includes full-time and part-time teachers

claims.text: India has 58.6 percent, while the USA has 87.5 percent.
Stepping up the list, Moldova has 98.3 percent, Ukraine 98.6 percent, Kyrgyzstan 98.9 percent, and Russia 99.3 percent.
Belarus is the world's highest, where women account for 99.5 percent of primary teachers.
What was the gender balance among your primary school teachers?
Who Taught You? Female Primary Teachers (%)
